rabbi-dostai-ben-yehuda.name: Rabbi Dostai ben Yehuda
rabbi-dostai-ben-yehuda.bio: Tanna of the generation of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi, cited in baraitot.
rabbi-dostai-ben-yehuda.prompt: A sage of the Land of Israel in his 50s with a greying dark beard and a plain wool mantle, a precise and measured expression as he weighs a point of exegesis; background of terraced Galilean fields and a stone study house.
